The '''Shawpee Gang'''<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|145|Shawpee Gang}}</ref> was a criminal organization which was formed in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] by a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|boy]] named [[Falk (criminal)|Falk]]<ref name="SWTSE" /> and the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Doda Bodonawieedo/Legends|Doda Bodonawieedo]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Falk gathered other youths to form a gang of<ref name="SWTSE" /> small-time [[Gangster/Legends|hoodlums]] who prowled Mos Eisley's streets,<ref name="TCSWE" /> and they were initially content with break-ins, muggings, and fighting with rival gangs.<ref name="SWTSE" />

In [[Time/Legends|time]], as they grew older, the Shawpees formed ties with Mos Eisley's criminal underworld and eventually moved into protection rackets, running numbers and [[Spice/Legends|spice]], and [[Dealmaker|fencing]] operations. As a [[Musician/Legends|minstrel]] and as Falk's friend, Bodonawieedo himself managed to remain relatively free of criminal activity.<ref name="SWTSE" />

By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates {{Film|IV}}, which includes the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]], to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Since ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'' mentions that Greedo was alive when [[Doda Bodonawieedo/Legends|Doda Bodonawieedo]] and [[Falk (criminal)|Falk]] left the Shawpees and joined [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire]], their departure must have occurred by 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> Bodonawieedo and Falk left the Shawpees to join [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|gang]], which was also based on Tatooine.<ref name="SWTSE" /> The Shawpee Gang itself also fell in with Jabba's gang at some point preceding the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY's]] [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]].<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|75|MAX 7-10|Max Rebo Band}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Shawpee gang was first mentioned in [[1997]]'s ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'', a supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="SWTSE" /> [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' uses the capitalization "Shawpee Gang."<ref name="TCSWE" />
